description: Receives authenticated Pebble ring events and delivers their sanitized metadata and transcript to the CodeTerm General Agent.
configHelp: Requires CodeTerm 1.10.19+ with multipart webhook support. Prod BLACKSTAR URL: https://blackstar.tail0e459c.ts.net/api/plugins/pebble/webhook. In CoreApp set that URL, add Authorization: Bearer <the value of pebble_webhook_secret>, and select Transcription only. Retrieve the token from CodeTerm Settings > Secrets or codeterm mem secret get --name pebble_webhook_secret on prod; it is not the CodeTerm API token and never belongs in the URL. Do not override Content-Type: CoreApp supplies multipart/form-data with its boundary. HTTP 415 means the host or media type is wrong.
